purpose: Capture actual response snapshots from the LLM and deterministic response paths for the seven canonical held-out questions. Null means no verified fixture has been captured; do not replace null with authored or simulated output.
source_capture_policy: Populate only from an actual, attributable execution of the named response path. Record runtime identity, commit/fingerprint, timestamp, request identifier where available, and transport outcome. Preserve raw response text. Never infer a missing path output from the other path.

cases.query: At standard atmospheric pressure, what temperature does water boil at?
What is cosmology, and why does it matter to how people live?
How can an organization put trust into practice?
Should a growing nonprofit centralize decisions or distribute authority across its teams?
How can I verify that a Python service has a required environment variable configured without exposing its secret value?
What caused the sudden increase in our website traffic last week?
Explain the difference between a policy and a procedure in plain language. Do not recommend resources, links, or follow-up steps.
